messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: KV-cache continuous-batching error spike detected for /generate-route — high 5xx rate and batch fragmentation. link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1845 runbook: https://go/runbooks/kvcache-batch

maya: oncall ack — jumping in. any idea which variant/route?

jordan: seeing a huge increase in cache misses correlated with requests that include function-calling + structured output. logs show repeated small batches being torn down when tool calls present. sample log:```
2026-02-14T18:02:12Z ERROR batch_manager: batch_break_detected reason=struct-output function_call=true batch_size=1 kv_cache_miss=true key_hash=af3b...
2026-02-14T18:02:12Z WARN  kvcache: key-signature-mismatch schema_v=2 request_schema={...} cached_prefix=\"usr|prompt_hash\"
```

sam: hmm. this started right after the kvcache schema segmentation rollout (v2) + the continuous-batching change that opts to break batches on tool calls. those two together would multiply cache keys and reduce prefix reuse.

maya: impact? customer-facing?

customer-success: early telemetry: ~8 customers reporting elevated error responses, overall 9% error spike on gen endpoints, 12%+ for customers heavily using function-calls (notably invoice-extractor). CS is triaging priority accounts.

jordan: root cause hypothesis: structured output + function_call handling flips a flag that partitions KV cache keys per schema variant. combined with break-on-toolcall policy this creates many 1-item batches and cache churn. memory pressure + eviction causes more cache misses -> cascade.

sam: mitigation options:
- flip the rollout for kvcache schema segmentation back to v1 (rollback).
- temporarily disable break-on-toolcall so batches stay coalesced.
- route function-call-heavy traffic to model-compat fallback (slower but stable).

maya: i'd prefer minimal blast radius quickly: flip the break-on-toolcall flag to false (config toggle) first, then monitor. if that fails, rollback segmentation.

devon: preparing quick config change. command i will run:```
# disable batch break on tool calls globally (short term)
redwoodctl config set runtime.batch.break_on_toolcall false --env prod --reason "inc 1845000000: stop batch fragmentation"
# increase kvcache eviction threshold as fallback
redwoodctl config set runtime.kvcache.eviction_threshold 0.85 --env prod --reason "inc 1845000000: mitigate churn"
```

devon: running now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by devon for config-change/runtime (id: cfg-9876)

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded — cfg-9876 applied to prod workers (rolling 50% -> 100%).

maya: monitoring dashboards. initial signal: 30s post-change saw batch size median move from 1.2 to 6.1 for affected route. error rate trending down but still ~3% above baseline.

jordan: logs now show far fewer batch_break_detected entries. sample:```
2026-02-14T18:06:43Z INFO  batch_manager: batch_coalesce reason=timeout batch_size=7 kv_cache_hit=true
```

customer-success: affected customers reporting fewer errors, some still seeing intermittent failures for older in-flight sessions. CS continuing outreach.

maya: ok next step: keep config disabled for 30m-1h while we validate. if stable, we'll roll forward a controlled rollback of kvcache segmentation v2 to v1 to fully revert the change that amplified the key space. jordan can you prepare the rollback plan?

jordan: already prepping rollback change: will revert deployment tag kvcache-segmentation:v2 -> v1. will require graceful drain (5m) and small canary then full. estimate 20 min to complete.

maya: handing off to sre-oncall for watch and customer comms. @sre-oncall take over?

sre-oncall: taking over incident — will watch metrics and coordinate rollback if needed. I'll ping @eli for postmortem owners.

sre-oncall: live metrics snapshot: error-rate for /generate-route now 1.8% above baseline, median latency stable. memory eviction dropped 40% from peak.

eli: noted for postmortem. please capture timeline, config flags toggled, and customer impact. we'll want an RCA and action items (feature flagging rollout safety, canary metrics guard rails, and doc for toolcall cache semantics).

jordan: if we still see residual customer failures after config toggle + kvcache rollback, plan B is to route function-call-heavy customers to fallback model variant and enable request-level retry with backoff.

sre-oncall: standing by. will escalate to eng-runtime if error rate doesn't fall below 0.5% above baseline in 45m.

maya: nice job folks. will keep incident open until postmortem created. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread (handoff to sre-oncall)
